meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 装到 Cursor 后，claude-mem 会启动本地 worker，随插件自带的 hooks 一起运行，MCP 服务 claude-mem-local 与它通信；也可改成远程 worker，让 claude-mem-remote 连你的服务器。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装配置 claude-mem 时触发，用于选择本地或远程 worker、本地主机登录 observer 或 cmem.ai 远程推理等设置。

say.text: 在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem，用默认的本地 worker
把 claude-mem 装成远程 worker，服务器地址用我的地址
把 observer 改成本地主机登录的方式

howto.what_en: On Cursor, claude-mem starts a local worker alongside the plugin's bundled hooks; the claude-mem-local MCP server talks to it. It can also run as a remote worker, with claude-mem-remote connecting to your server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set up claude-mem on Cursor: choosing a local or remote worker, a local host-login observer, or cmem.ai remote inference.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the default local worker
Install claude-mem as a remote worker using my server URL
Switch the observer to local host-login
